notes: Keyring (KEYR) launch on Sepolia. LaunchToken (src/LaunchToken.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments, 18 decimals, and 1,000,000,000 KEYR minted once to the deploying factory; it has no mint or admin functions. KeyringMultisig (src/KeyringMultisig.sol) is the single application contract: its only constructor argument is the KEYR token address ($token), stored immutable and exposed as token(). It keeps many 2-of-3 wallets as ids in its own storage with separate per-wallet ETH and KEYR ledgers, deploys no contracts, holds nothing at deploy, and has no owner, admin, pause, upgrade, receive/fallback, or rescue path, so no $owner argument is used. The constructor is nonpayable and makes no token movement; no initialization calls are required. KEYR for deposits comes from swapping Sepolia ETH in the native-ETH launch pool the factory seeds (no hook). KEYR sent directly to KeyringMultisig without depositToken is untracked and unrecoverable.
